requirements_summary: Primary objective: VPC-hosted Redwood Private with full audit logging exported to Vertus SIEM and S3 archival under customer CMK.
SIEM export: must support HTTPS JSON (Splunk HEC), syslog over TLS (RFC5424), and CEF/LEEF for legacy pipelines; batched and realtime options.

Log schema (required fields): timestamp_iso, request_id, request_origin_ip (redacted), internal_user_id (pseudonymized), request_role, model_id, model_version, prompt_hash (sha256), prompt_token_count, response_token_count, latency_ms, status_code, truncation_flag, route, region, tenant_id, resource_owner, event_type (request|response|cache_hit|fallback), signature_hmac_sha256, retention_class.
Access logs: admin console actions (login, token creation/revocation, role changes), API key usage, and SE/debug session recordings; all must include actor, ip, timestamp, and action_type.

Retention policy: 90 days hot searchable in SIEM, 1 year warm, 7 years cold archive on S3 Glacier Deep Archive (customer may request shorter retention for PII), with immutability/lock options for regulatory holds.
Integrity & non-repudiation: support append-only logs, stream-level HMAC signing and periodic signed manifests; ability to provide signed proofs during incidents.
KMS integration: customer-managed CMK for S3 envelope encryption and for signing metadata. Support for AWS KMS and HSM-backed keys; key rotation and key access audit must be visible to Vertus SIEM.

PII handling: Redwood to support field-level redaction/pseudonymization prior to export and supply a mapping artifact under a separate secure channel; Vertus insisted no raw PII inside logs unless explicitly approved.

Export frequency & throughput: must handle bursts to 10k qps; support real-time streaming and hourly batched upload for cold archive. Export must have backpressure and retries, with dead-letter queue to S3 for failed payloads.
Searchability: logs exported to SIEM should be indexed with recommended tags (tenant_id, model_id, event_type, region, prompt_hash) and include token counters for cost reconciliation.
Alerting hooks: webhook/trace links on error events and anomalous model outputs; Vertus wants integrations into PagerDuty and their SOAR playbooks.
Data residency: primary storage in us-east-1; cross-region replication only to us-west-2 with customer opt-in. No EU/APAC replicas for this deployment.
Operational SLAs: Redwood to provide delivery latency for log export (<= 30s for realtime pipeline) and delivery receipts for batched archive jobs.
Documentation deliverables requested: log field glossary (CSV), sample JSON payloads (10k qps simulation), SIEM connector runbook, KMS CMK policy template, and retention cost estimator.
